entities.summary: Renaud Émile Gontran Muselier is a French-Mauritian physician and politician who has served as President of the Regional Council of Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur since 2017. A member of The Republicans (LR) until 2021, he joined Renaissance (RE) the following year. He previously was a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 2014 to 2019.
